CAREER NOTES
Athletic: 2022 Olympian…three-time IIHF World Championships participant (2021, 2022, 2023)…

2022-23 | REDSHIRT SEASON:
Season: Redshirted in her first season with St. Cloud State…

INTERNATIONAL CAREER (SWITZERLAND):
2023 World Championships: Helped the Swiss take fourth, skating in six games…
2022 World Championships: Appeared in four games, recording a pair of assists...helped the Swiss to a fourth-place finish...tallied an assist against Japan and Canada...
Beijing 2022 Winter Olympics: Made her Olympic debut and skated in seven games...
2021 World Championships: Scored a goal in her debut Worlds with the Swiss...found the back of the net for the game-winner in overtime against the ROC...
2020 U18 Junior World Championships: Skated in five games with Switzerland’s Juniors team…scored four goals with one assist for a five-point tournament…skated to a plus-four...
2019 U18 Junior World Championships: Debuted with the Swiss Juniors team and scored a goal with three assists for four points in five games…
 
Prep: Spent four seasons with EV Bomo Thun in the Swiss Women's Hockey League A (SWHL A)...played in 25 games in 2021-22, scoring 21 goals with 18 assists for 39 points...scored 22 goals with two assists for 24 points in 20 games of action during the 2020-21 campaign...delivered a 14-6-20 line over 14 games in 2019-20...made her EV Bomo Thun debut in 2018-19, scoring four goals with four apples for eight points...also played stints with SC Reinach Damen (2017-18) and SC Winfelden Ladies (2016-17) in the SWHL A...
 
Personal: The daughter of Michael and Barbara Wagner…has one brother, Lukas...majoring in Exercise Science…
